known_risks.name: fbdev_24bpp_copy
known_risks.value: Archived fbdev treats 24bpp like 32bpp and copies four bytes per pixel.
known_risks.risk: Packed 24bpp can be misaddressed and overrun rows or mapped memory.

known_risks.name: fbdev_channel_layout
known_risks.value: Archived fbdev copies LVGL color bytes without validating channel offsets.
known_risks.risk: RGB/BGR/alpha mismatch can produce swapped colors even when bpp is 32.

known_risks.name: fbdev_map_failed_check
known_risks.value: Archived flush checks NULL rather than reliably tracking MAP_FAILED.
known_risks.risk: A failed mapping can be dereferenced and crash the process.

known_risks.name: fbdev_missing_munmap
known_risks.value: Archived fbdev exit closes the descriptor but does not call munmap.
known_risks.risk: Resource cleanup and restart behavior are incomplete.

known_risks.name: fbdev_initialization_status
known_risks.value: Archived fbdev_init returns void and leaves the caller unable to distinguish failure.
known_risks.risk: LVGL may register and use a display driver after initialization failed.

known_risks.name: evdev_tracking_id
known_risks.value: Archived evdev treats only tracking ID 0 as press.
known_risks.risk: Any nonzero valid tracking ID may be interpreted incorrectly; Linux uses any nonnegative ID for contact and -1 for release.

known_risks.name: old_tick_wall_clock
known_risks.risk: Clock adjustments and 32-bit intermediate arithmetic can break LVGL timing.

known_risks.name: old_freetype_architecture_mix
known_risks.value: Archived static and shared FreeType artifacts came from different compiler/CPU baselines.
known_risks.source: Prior read-only ELF metadata audit of reference/six/six/freetypelib/lib
known_risks.risk: Artifact architecture alone cannot prove compatibility with either current compiler candidate or sysroot.

known_risks.name: old_build_files
known_risks.value: Archived Makefile and CMakeLists.txt are not equivalent and are not safe new-project build inputs.
known_risks.risk: Short compiler names, absent sysroot selection, static linking, host pkg-config, and old business source lists can contaminate a build.

known_risks.name: old_deployment_scripts
known_risks.value: Archived install/run scripts use root-owned absolute paths and old plaintext account files.
known_risks.risk: Executing them can overwrite system paths, deploy unrelated business data, and expose credentials.
